## Domain 1: Section 195 & Form 13 Lower TDS Certificate on NRI Property Sales
URL: https://www.fin2excel.com/services/lower-tds-certificate-form-13

### The Statutory Problem
When a resident Indian sells an immovable property, the buyer deducts TDS under Section 194-IA at just 1% of the sale value. However, when a Non-Resident Indian (NRI) sells an immovable property in India, withholding tax is governed by Section 195 of the Income Tax Act, 1961. 

Under Section 195:
- The buyer is legally required to deduct TDS at 20% on Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) or 30% on Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG), plus applicable surcharge (up to 15% or 25%) and 4% Health and Education Cess.
- Because the buyer and sub-registrar do not have the legal mandate to calculate net capital gains or indexation, TDS is deducted on the **GROSS SALE CONSIDERATION** unless a specific certificate is presented.
- Effective withholding tax on gross value:
  - Sale price up to ₹50 Lakhs: 20.8%
  - Sale price ₹50 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore: 22.88% (10% surcharge)
  - Sale price ₹1 Crore to ₹2 Crore: 23.92% (15% surcharge)
  - Sale price above ₹2 Crore: 23.92%

### Financial Impact Example
On an apartment sold in South Delhi for ₹5,00,00,000 (₹5 Crore):
- Standard Section 195 TDS (23.92% on gross consideration): ₹1,19,60,000 (₹1.20 Crore).
- If the indexed cost of acquisition is ₹3.8 Crore, actual long-term capital gains are only ₹1.2 Crore.
- At 20% on net gains, actual tax liability is ₹28.7 Lakh.
- Result: ₹90,90,000 (over ₹90 Lakhs) of the NRI seller's legitimate money is locked up in government withholding for 12 to 18 months until the Indian tax return is processed and refund is issued.

### The Solution: Form 13 Lower/Nil Deduction Certificate
Under Section 197 of the Income Tax Act, an NRI seller can apply online on the Traces portal (Form 13) requesting the jurisdictional Assessing Officer (International Taxation) to issue a certificate authorizing the buyer to deduct tax at a lower rate or Nil rate.

### Documents Required for Form 13 Filing:
1. PAN Card copies of NRI Seller and Buyer.
2. Passport and OCI Card of NRI Seller.
3. Registered Agreement to Sell (ATS) executed with the buyer.
4. Mother Deed / Original Purchase Deed establishing acquisition date and cost.
5. Proof of construction, renovation, or improvement costs (if applicable).
6. Computation of Capital Gains with Cost Inflation Indexation (CII).
7. Bank statements (NRO/NRE) reflecting transaction history.
8. Past 3 Assessment Years Indian Income Tax Returns (ITRs) and computation sheets (if filed).
9. TAN (Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number) of the buyer.
10. If claiming capital gains exemption: Proof of investment or intent to invest in residential property under Section 54 or Capital Gains Bonds under Section 54EC (REC / PFC / NHAI).

### Processing Timeline:
- Standard statutory processing time: 21 to 30 business days from complete submission on Traces.
- The resulting certificate is digitally signed and contains a unique verification code, uploaded directly to the Traces portal for the buyer's TAN to apply at the sub-registrar office.

## Domain 2: NRI Fund Repatriation (Form 15CA & Form 15CB)
URL: https://www.fin2excel.com/services/nri-fund-repatriation-15ca-15cb

### Legal Framework
Under the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Foreign Exchange Management (Remittance of Assets) Regulations, 2016, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) are permitted to remit abroad an amount up to **USD 1,000,000 (One Million US Dollars) per financial year** (April 1 to March 31) out of balances held in their Non-Resident Ordinary (NRO) accounts.

### Eligible Repatriation Sources:
- Net proceeds from sale of Indian residential or commercial real estate.
- Inheritance from parents, relatives, or legal wills.
- Liquidation of Indian mutual funds, shares, and securities.
- Accumulated rental income and dividends.
- Maturity proceeds of fixed deposits and insurance policies.

### The Compliance Mechanism:
1. **Form 15CB (Chartered Accountant Certificate)**:
   - Mandatory certification by an independent Chartered Accountant.
   - The CA audits the nature of the remittance, verifies that appropriate Indian income tax (capital gains, rental TDS, wealth tax) has been paid, verifies Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) provisions, and determines exact tax deductibility.
   - Signed with CA UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number).
2. **Form 15CA (Taxpayer Undertaking)**:
   - Filed electronically on the Income Tax e-Filing portal.
   - Part C is filed where remittance exceeds ₹5 Lakh in a financial year and requires Form 15CB.
   - Contains remitter details, beneficiary foreign bank account details, and SWIFT code.
3. **Form A2 (FEMA Declaration)**:
   - Application cum declaration submitted to the Authorized Dealer Category-1 (AD Cat-1) bank in India specifying the purpose of remittance under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme.

## Domain 3: NRI Property Concierge & Real Estate Stewardship in Delhi NCR
URL: https://www.fin2excel.com/services/nri-property-management-delhi

### Target Micro-Markets:
- **South Delhi**: Greater Kailash (GK-I, GK-II), Vasant Vihar, Defence Colony, Anand Niketan, Shanti Niketan, Jor Bagh, Gulmohar Park, Panchsheel Park, New Friends Colony.
- **Gurugram (Gurgaon)**: Golf Course Road, DLF Phase 1, 2, 4, 5, Golf Course Extension Road, Ambience Island, Central Park.
- **Noida**: Sectors 14, 15A, 44, 128 (Jaypee Greens).

### Scope of Services:
1. **Tenant Due Diligence & KYC**: Complete background verification of potential tenants, employment vetting, drafting of bi-lingual registered lease agreements with clear eviction clauses.
2. **Physical Site Inspections & Audits**: Bi-annual comprehensive physical inspections with high-definition photo/video logs verifying structural condition, waterproofing, and unauthorized encroachments.
3. **Municipal & Tax Compliance**: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) Property Tax assessment, Unique Property Identification Code (UPIC) linking, mutation records, and water/electricity bill auditing.
4. **Dispute Resolution & Eviction Assistance**: Legal notices, conciliation, and representation via empanelled High Court advocates for illegal possession or tenant holdover.
5. **Liquidation & Sale Management**: End-to-end representation under Power of Attorney (POA) for property valuation, buyer negotiation, sub-registrar execution, and Form 13 / 15CA repatriation integration.

## Domain 4: Elder Care Concierge & Medical Logistics (Delhi NCR)
URL: https://www.fin2excel.com/services/elder-care-concierge-delhi-ncr

### Purpose
To provide dignified, transparent, single-point logistics and healthcare accompaniment for the aging parents of global Indians living abroad.

### Partner Hospitals & Micro-Districts:
- Max Super Speciality Hospital (Saket, Panchsheel Park, Gurugram)
- Medanta – The Medicity (Gurugram)
- Fortis Memorial Research Institute (FMRI Gurugram, Vasant Kunj)
- Apollo Hospitals (Indraprastha, South Delhi)

### Core Capabilities:
1. **Hospital & Clinical Accompaniment**: Dedicated personal concierge accompanies parents from doorstep into OPD consultations, diagnostics, and admission procedures, providing real-time audio/video debriefs to family abroad.
2. **24/7 Emergency Bridge**: Rapid response protocol for medical emergencies, coordinating private advanced life support (ALS) ambulances and emergency room triage.
3. **Prescription Fulfillment & Chronic Care**: Automated delivery of authentic pharmaceuticals, home health nurse dispatch, blood sample collection, and physiotherapist coordination.
4. **Household Logistics**: Verified emergency electricians, plumbers, utility bill automation, and domestic staff background checks.
